claims.paraphrase: Page title.
Page tagline.
Three routing bullets to the diagnostic pages.
Section heading.
Confirm logging is on by running cairn doctor and checking the observability condition.
Once on, the site writes one structured record per event with name, level, timestamp, and fields.
Read logs through Workers Logs in the dashboard or wrangler tail.
The full event list is in the reference.
Records carry the editor email, never a token or session id.
Section heading.
Symptom: the sign-in link never sends or never arrives.
The sending-domain check runs through cairn health once the site is adopted.
The auth store has no command yet; check the database by hand.
Confirm the person email is on the roster; sign-in looks the email up in the allowlist.
The ordinary check-your-inbox message is the same whether or not the address is on the roster.
Message: you requested a link recently, check your inbox or wait a minute.
Message: trouble sending sign-in links right now.
Those two messages appear only for roster addresses.
A link works only in the requesting browser; another browser shows no pending sign-in.
Mail apps with built-in viewers are the usual cause.
A developer can seed a recovery magic_token row with a null nonce_hash for a locked-out sole owner.
Log events: requested, minted, send_failed, refused.
Section heading.
Symptom: a form is refused immediately.
The guard rejects requests before the screen behind them.
cairn health checks HTTPS once the site is adopted.
CSRF token rejections are not reported by the doctor.
Origin rejections are not reported by the doctor; both appear as guard.refused records.
A missing database binding makes every admin page, sign-in included, show the same branded error.
guard.refused reason values are https, csrf, origin, and bindings.
Section heading.
Symptom: a save or publish is refused.
A conflict means the entry changed on GitHub since opening; review and save again.
Non-conflict failures usually implicate the GitHub App.
Debug pointer for saves failing after a successful publish.
Publish site appears only when something is pending to publish.
Inside an entry the Publish site button stands down.
If GitHub cannot be read, the button is hidden rather than showing a guessed count.
Apply the same GitHub App check to a missing button.
commit.failed on a save carries reason conflict or an error field naming GitHub answer.
publish.failed on a publish has the same shape.
A github.unreachable record marks the worrying missing-button case.
Section heading.
Symptom: a person signs in but every screen refuses them.
An undeclared role resolves to no access, so every screen refuses the person.
The refusal logs an auth.role.unknown record.
Section heading.
Symptom: an image will not upload.
The reason field names the upload failure: too_large, unsupported_type, session_expired.
The other reasons are operational refusals that need a developer.
Failed uploads log a media.upload_failed record.
Section heading.
The admin shows a calm failure message instead of a raw crash.
Claim: the strip means a custom screen or action threw.
Log event admin.action.failed with the message in its error field.
Claim: the author of the custom screen should receive the record.
